# Display the final script
echo "=== /app/apply_macros.vim ==="
cat apply_macros.vim

echo ""
echo "=== Keystroke Count ==="
# Count keystrokes in each macro (the strings in setreg calls)
grep "call setreg" apply_macros.vim | while read line; do
    # Extract the string between quotes after the register name
    macro=$(echo "$line" | sed -n "s/.*setreg('\([a-c]\)', \"\(.*\)\").*/\1: \2/p")
    echo "$macro" | awk -F': ' '{print "Macro " $1 ": " length($2) " keystrokes"}'
done

echo ""
echo "Total keystrokes in macros:"
grep "call setreg" apply_macros.vim | sed -n 's/.*", "\(.*\)").*/\1/p' | awk '{s+=length($0)} END {print s}'
